reportText: Tell the moderators what is wrong. They review reports within 24 hours.
commentHint: Up to 1000 characters. Only moderators see it.
sent: Thank you. The report has been sent to the moderators; you will be notified about the decision.
hiddenNotice: This content has been hidden by the moderators.
bannedNotice: Your account is blocked. You can read the site, but you cannot publish, RSVP or chat.
notifyReportResolved: Your report was reviewed and the moderators took action.
notifyReportDismissed: Your report was reviewed; the moderators found no violation.
notifyClaimApproved: Your profile claim was approved. The profile is now yours.
error_GENERIC: Could not send the report. Try again.
error_OWN_CONTENT: You cannot report your own content.
error_RATE_LIMITED: Too many reports. Try again in an hour.
error_UNAUTHORIZED: Sign in to send a report.
error_INVALID_INPUT: Check the form and try again.
